message.content:
The copy-assignment path default-constructs both vectors and then reallocates to copy; using the member-initializer list copy-constructs each vector directly, so each gets exactly one allocation and a `memcpy`, with no empty-vector setup or self-assignment checks.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values),
      stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
